from itertools import combinations
from pysat.solvers import Glucose3

n=8
edges=list(combinations(range(n),2))
idx={e:i+1 for i,e in enumerate(edges)}
s=Glucose3()
for clique in combinations(range(n),4):
    lits=[idx[(a,b)] for a,b in combinations(clique,2)]
    s.add_clause([-l for l in lits])
    s.add_clause(lits)
print(s.solve())
m=s.get_model()
res=[(1 if idx[e] in set(m) else 0) for e in edges]
# but want 0 for negative, 1 for positive
res=[(1 if l>0 else 0) for l in m[:28]]
print(res)
# verify
for clique in combinations(range(n),4):
    vals=[res[idx[(a,b)]-1] for a,b in combinations(clique,2)]
    assert not all(v==0 for v in vals)
    assert not all(v==1 for v in vals)
print("ok")
